messages:
chloe (Finance): FYI partner StripeLine reported a missing negative adjustment on AWS invoice AWS-INV-99012 after they requested an expedited refund tied to a SKU consolidation on 2026-06-12. Amount ~USD 2,150. They see the charge but no corresponding credit. @matt can you pull mapping and request evidence?
matt (Partner Ops): looking. I see the consolidation request from partner (ticket attached). There was a consolidation from sku-sL-01 -> sku-sL-02; system created a refund event but it didn't attach to the settlement batch. @billing-bot can you pull settlement rows for partner SL-09 Jun 10-15?
billing-bot: Query complete. Missing negative adjustment row expected: should be SLR-4510 (-2150). Settlement batch GCP-SETTLE-.. none attached. Created internal ticket FIN-3820. Linked logs uploaded to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/sl-09-missing-refund.csv
olga (RevOps): Thanks. I'll draft a settlement adjustment to partner and include the original consolidation request. Preference is to issue settlement adj to partner rather than ask AWS to reissue end-customer invoices.
kevin (Sales): Partner wants the credit applied before their month-end close. Is there an expedited path with AWS marketplace ops?
olga (RevOps): We can flag the request as expedited when sending to AWS settlement ops but SLA still 3-7 business days. We'll issue an internal settlement adjustment to partner ledger immediately (provisional) and then route to AWS.
chloe (Finance): Draft details: reason = "missing negative adjustment after SKU consolidation", amount = "USD 2,150", invoice ref = "AWS-INV-99012", GL = "4210". Please include FIN-3820 and partner consolidation request. Approvers: @hana (Finance Lead).
olga (RevOps): Draft credit memo:

``
Credit memo to StripeLine (partner id SL-09)
Amount: USD 2,150
Reason: Missing negative adjustment following SKU consolidation (sku-sL-01 -> sku-sL-02) on 2026-06-12. Adjustment expected but not attached to settlement batch.
Related invoice: AWS-INV-99012
GL code: 4210 (Marketplace rebates)
Internal ticket: FIN-3820
Attachments: consolidation request, settlement logs
``

Approver: @hana (Finance Lead).
hana (Finance Lead): Approved. Post provisional contra to ledger and route to AWS settlements with expedited flag. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Submitted adjustment to AWS Marketplace ops: AWS-SETTLE-9199. ETA 4-6 business days. FIN-3820 linked.
chloe (Finance): Logged provisional journal entry and noted as pending in close workbook. Notifying partner of timeline. Thanks all.
matt (Partner Ops): Notified partner and attached settlement ticket. :thumbsup:
